verdicts.reason: Both share the same flaws. The phone illustration is jammed against the top edge, and its cream circle is cut by the left edge. The subhead is indented about 105px while the headline sits at 48px, so the left edges don't line up. The tilted badge and the CTA pill sit on different axes, and about 120px of dead space is left at the bottom. In A, the larger two-line headline keeps tighter, even gaps and gives a clearer hierarchy. In B, the one-line headline floats in a loose middle band, with big gaps above and below that pull the text away from its group.
